# My plan for this year

*(Sitting on the doorstep, thinking it over)*

I've been farming this same 9 mu for 30 years now. Same fields, same rotation — wheat then maize, wheat then maize. My husband and I do most of the work. Our oldest son works in Handan city and sends money, our younger boy helps when he's back. With just the two of us in the field most days, I can't do anything fancy. I do what I know works.

**Wheat (going in this October on all 9 mu):**

I'll plant around the Cold Dew festival, same as always — if I wait too long the wheat won't tiller enough before winter. I buy seed from the co-op, the common variety everyone around here plants — I don't remember the name, the shopkeeper just gives me what people are buying. About 15 jin per mu for seed.

Before plowing I spread one bag of compound fertilizer (那种三个十五的, the 15-15-15) for every 2 mu — so about 4 and a half bags for the whole field. Then when the wheat starts jointing around Qingming, I topdress urea — about half a bag per mu. That's what my neighbor Old Wang does and his wheat always looks good. If the wheat looks yellow I might add a little more, but urea is expensive so I don't waste it.

Water — I'll irrigate before the ground freezes (越冬水), again at jointing, and once more when the grain is filling if it hasn't rained. The well is ours to share with three other families, and pumping costs money, so I don't water more than I have to. Three times is enough most years.

For weeds I spray once in spring — the village shop sells a bottle that kills the grass weeds. If I see aphids in May I'll spray once more. Harvest I hire the combine, 60 yuan/mu, comes through the village. 

I'm hoping for 800 jin/mu (400 kg) — last year I got a bit better than that, year before was dry and I only got maybe 700. Depends on the rain.

**Maize (going in right after wheat harvest, around June 15th):**

The turnaround is always tight — combine finishes wheat, I rush to get maize in the ground before the heat. I don't plow, just direct-seed into the wheat stubble. Hire the seeder, it does the work in one pass.

Seed is hybrid — has to be, you can't save maize seed, it doesn't come back right. I buy the same brand my cousin uses. About 50 yuan/mu for seed.

For fertilizer, maize is different because there's no time to topdress carefully when the weather is so hot. I put down one bag of compound per 1.3 mu at planting, then when the maize is knee-high I scatter urea, about 15 jin/mu, and irrigate to wash it in. That's two trips through the field, which is already a lot of walking.

Water — if June is dry I irrigate right after planting to get emergence. Then maybe once more at tasseling if the rains don't come. Usually it rains enough in July and August.

Herbicide at planting — the seeder applies it. Then I walk the field and if I see armyworm I spray. 

I hope for 900 jin/mu (450 kg). The maize yields have been decent.

---

## Tradeoffs I think about

- More fertilizer might give more yield, but compound is almost 3.5 yuan a jin now. I only have so much cash after the kids' expenses. I'd rather be a little short than waste money.
- I could irrigate more but the electricity for the pump adds up. Three times on wheat, once or twice on maize — that's my rule.
- I can't afford to hire much labor. Me and my husband do the spraying, the fertilizing, the walking of the fields. The combine and seeder I hire because I can't do those by myself.
